ClickToUse.en: Press any key to use the mediator

TUTO_Welcome.en: Welcome to the Yokai Night Market!

TUTO_Obj.zh: 目标：比隔壁摊先完成五项筹备。
TUTO_Obj.en: Finish all five preparations before the rival stall.

TUTO_Para.zh:
每个摊位抽到一份不同的委托。
左边数字是已完成工作，右边是所需工作。
TUTO_Para.en:
Each stall draws a different opening order.
The left number is work done; the right is work needed.

TUTO_Turno.zh:
每轮先自动修补、推进在岗帮工，再补牌。
随后可以连续出牌，准备好就交班。
TUTO_Turno.en:
A shift starts with automatic repairs and helper progress,
then draws cards. Play as many cards as you can, then pass.

TUTO_Cada.zh:
帮工需工作两轮或四轮，完成一项筹备后离岗。
第一个上岗的帮工决定本轮可招募的岗位。
TUTO_Cada.en:
Helpers take two or four shifts to finish one task and leave.
The first helper hired limits this shift to that department.

TUTO_Termina.zh:
先完成招徕、料理、备货、灯饰、护阵的摊位获胜。
筹备完成时立即结算。
TUTO_Termina.en:
Finish calling, cooking, supplies, decor and wards to win.
The result is settled immediately when the order is ready.

TUTO2_Dev.en: Helpers work on one preparation at your stall.

TUTO2_Neg.zh: 闹场使隔壁停工；挖角作用于在岗帮工。
TUTO2_Neg.en: Trouble pauses rival helpers. Interventions target working helpers.

TUTO2_Pos.zh: 搭把手：推进、完工、开放岗位或减需求。
TUTO2_Pos.en: Helping hands progress work or simplify preparations.

TUTO2_Esp.zh: 修补解除事件；调停在巡街倒计时内反制。
TUTO2_Esp.en: Repairs remove trouble; mediators cancel inspections.

TUTO2_Juega.zh: 点牌使用；空格或右键交班，Tab 快进。
TUTO2_Juega.en: Click to play; Space or right-click passes; Tab fast-forwards.

TUTO2_Buena.en: Ring the bell and open your stall!
